cues.zhText: 一顿再普通不过的午饭后，你的肚脐周围，突然开始隐隐作痛，甚至泛起恶心，连吐了两次。
cues.enText: After an ordinary lunch, a dull ache starts around your navel, bringing nausea and two bouts of vomiting.

cues.zhText: 这会儿炎症还藏在阑尾内层，疼痛借着内脏神经往外传，定位含糊不清，像在和你捉迷藏。
cues.enText: Inflammation is still tucked inside the inner wall; visceral nerves carry vague signals, playing hide-and-seek.

cues.zhText: 可窗外的太阳落下去、弯月升起来，傍晚六点，这股疼突然“搬了家”，死死钉在了右下腹的麦氏点——一按就痛，松手更痛。
cues.enText: As the sun sets and the moon rises at 6 PM, the pain suddenly migrates to McBurney's point—tender to press, worse on release.

cues.zhText: 熬到晚上十点急诊入院，体温飙到三十九点三度，白细胞和中性粒细胞全线拉响警报。
cues.enText: By 10 PM in the ER, your fever hits 39.3°C, while white blood cells and neutrophils sound full alarm.

cues.zhText: 短短十个小时，腹腔深处那根原本粉白细长的“小香肠”，正经历一场触目惊心的变色日记：从粉、到红、到黄、甚至发黑。
cues.enText: In just ten hours, that pale-pink "little sausage" undergoes a dramatic color diary: from pink, to red, to yellow, even black.
